title: Input formats and outputs
text: data frame (tibble) one row per observation. Expression normalized (e.g. log-normalized, depth-corrected) numeric value; centred scaled internally. Non-finite values drop row. Context columns: numeric = continuous (e.g. leading principal components computed within cell type, pseudotime, activation score); factor/character = categorical (cell type, subtype, treatment). Numeric context standardized. Covariates enter main effects . Use cell-level covariates (library size, PCs expression, batch) donor-level covariates (age, sex, genetic PCs). Categorical covariates one-hot encoded “level” component. Donor IDs must match genetic input exactly (character comparison); donors without genotypes rows missing values dropped message.

title: Input formats and outputs
text: geno one GRM built supplied cis SNPs; several GRMs build (example lapply(split_snps(geno, 3), make_grm)) pass list grm. Select SNPs within ±500 kb gene (select_cis_snps()); genotypes standardized allele frequency GRM \(XX^\top/p\). GRMs computed GCTA can loaded read_grm_bin(). PLINK files read read_plink() (needs BEDMatrix package).

title: Input formats and outputs
text: perturb column perturbation (target) cell. Remove non-targeting controls control = "NT" (otherwise form large “perturbation”); min_cells drops perturbations cells. perturb_group either column named list perturbation vectors.

title: Input formats and outputs

Intercept pair-mean carries variance. elements: n_obs, n_donors, XtX/Xty (sufficient statistics), jackknife$estimates (leave-block-estimates, blocks × components), call.

title: Model
text: Let \(y_{im}\) normalized expression gene cell \(m\) individual \(\) (\(=1,\dots,n\); \(m=1,\dots,M_i\)), \(g_i\\mathbb{R}^p\) standardized cis-genotypes (default SNPs within ±500 kb gene), \(c_{im}\\mathbb{R}^K\) cell-state features (example leading within-cell-type principal components) \(o_{im}\\mathbb{R}^L\) covariates. \[ y_{im}= g_i^\top\beta + (g_i\otimes c_{im})^\top\gamma + c_{im}^\top\alpha + o_{im}^\top\eta + e_i + \varepsilon_{im}, \] independent random effects \[ \beta\sim N\!\left(0,\tfrac{\sigma_G^2}{p}I_p\right),\quad \gamma_k\sim N\!\left(0,\tfrac{\sigma_{G\times C,k}^2}{p}I_p\right),\quad e_i\sim N(0,\sigma_I^2),\quad \varepsilon_{im}\sim N(0,\sigma_\varepsilon^2). \] \(\beta\) main cis-genetic effect, \(\gamma_k\) effect modulated along cell-state axis \(k\), \(\alpha\) \(\eta\) non-genetic effects state covariates, \(e_i\) donor effect shared across cells \(\varepsilon_{im}\) cell-level noise. package \(\sigma_C^2\) \(\sigma_o^2\) denote variance contributed \(c^\top\alpha\) \(o^\top\eta\) (treated random).

what: 2. Haseman-Elston regression on pairs of cells
title: Model
text: Define cis-genetic relatedness (GRM) \[K^G_{ij}=\frac{g_i^\top g_j}{p}.\] two different cells \((,m)\neq(j,n)\), \[ \mathbb{E}(y_{im}y_{jn})=\sigma_G^2K^G_{ij} +\sum_{k=1}^{K_\text{int}}\sigma_{G\times C,k}^2K^G_{ij}c_{imk}c_{jnk} +\sigma_I^2\mathbf 1(=j) +\sum_{k=1}^{K}\sigma_{C,k}^2c_{imk}c_{jnk} +\sum_{l=1}^{L}\sigma_{O,l}^2o_{iml}o_{jnl}. \] residual term \(\sigma_\varepsilon^2\mathbf 1(=j,m=n)\) vanishes distinct cells. every term known kernel times unknown variance, variances estimated ordinary least squares cross-product \(y_{im}y_{jn}\) kernels pairs: \[ y_{im}y_{jn}\sim 1 + K^G_{ij} + \mathbf 1(=j) + \sum_k c_{imk}c_{jnk} + \sum_l o_{iml}o_{jnl} + \sum_{k=1}^{K_\text{int}} K^G_{ij}\,c_{imk}c_{jnk}. \] coefficients variance components \(\hat\sigma^2\) (leading 1 absorbs mean). estimator moment based: likelihood, iteration, remains valid without Gaussian errors (variances may come slightly negative; see Troubleshooting). Mapping package output (fit$coefficients$component): Variables standardized (mean 0, variance 1) default, estimate directly variance contribution scale standardized expression.

title: Model
text: perturbation screen unit links cells perturbation rather donor. \(p_m\) perturbation cell \(m\) \(c_m\\mathbb{R}^K\) (standardized) cell state, \[ y_m=b_{p_m}+\sum_k c_{mk}\alpha_k+\sum_k c_{mk}u_{p_mk}+\varepsilon_m, \] \[ b_p\sim N(0,\sigma_P^2),\quad \alpha_k\sim N(0,\sigma_{C,k}^2),\quad u_{pk}\sim N(0,\sigma_{P\times C,k}^2), \] \(\sigma^2_P\) perturbation-associated variance shared across states \(\sigma^2_{P\times C,k}\) variance perturbation response along axis \(k\). two cells \(m\neq n\) \[ y_my_n\sim 1+\mathbf 1(p_m=p_n)+\sum_k c_{mk}c_{nk}+\mathbf 1(p_m=p_n)\sum_k c_{mk}c_{nk}, \] .e. genetic kernel replaced “perturbation”. categorical context (cell type) last two terms use \(\mathbf 1(t_m=t_n)\). Perturbations can split groups, \(\sigma_P^2\) \(\sigma_{P\times C}^2\) (perturb_group). genes measured cells share pair kernels, schint_pert() builds \(X^\top X\) re-uses every gene.

title: Model
text: Forming cell pairs costs \(O(M^2K^2)\) time \(O(M^2)\) memory \(M\) cells, impossible millions cells. Every regressor models form \[ X_r[(,m),(j,n)] = \kappa_r(,j)\,\sum_q u_{rq}(,m)\,u_{rq}(j,n), \] donor kernel \(\kappa_r\) (-ones, \(\mathbf 1(=j)\), GRM, “perturbation”) times pair product cell-level features \(u_r\) (column ones, standardized covariate, one-hot encoding). normal equations need \[ (X^\top X)_{rs}=\sum_{<b}X_r[,b]X_s[,b],\qquad (X^\top y)_r=\sum_{<b}X_r[,b]\,y_ay_b . \] Write \(z_a=u_r()\odot u_s()\) let \(W_i=\sum_{\}z_a\) sum cells donor \(\). \[ (X^\top X)_{rs}=\tfrac12\Big[\sum_{,j}(\kappa_r\circ\kappa_s)_{ij}\,W_i^\top W_j -\sum_a(\kappa_r\circ\kappa_s)_{()()}\,\lVert z_a\rVert^2\Big], \] \((X^\top y)_r\) expression \(z_a=u_r()\,y_a\) kernel \(\kappa_r\). donor-level sums \(W_i\) needed, cost \(O(N^2K^2)\) time \(O(N^2)\) memory \(N\) donors, independent number cells except one linear pass. Solving small normal equations gives variance components. exactly equivalent regressing pairs (package tests explicit pairwise OLS).
